chapter: New York, Philadelphia and Harlem nightlife
title: Café Society Downtown with Art Tatum and others
summary: He describes the Café Society lineup, including Tatum, Lena Horne, Red Allen, Doc Cheatham and Teddy Wilson.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: But in New York City guys wondered for years how I was making it, and I had a very simple pattern. I went to the World Series, I went to the fights, you know, I played the Café Society Downtown with Art Tatum, Lena Horne, Henry Red Allen, Jay C. Higgenbotham, Doc Cheatham and J. C. Heard and ....firma la porte moi!.......Open the window!.....
Eddie Heywood and Art, of course, Teddy Wilson...is there a piano player named Kenneth Spencer? No, Kenny Spencer was a singer. What's this boy's name used to play with Red Allen?
Kenny Kersey. Good piano player. Kenny Percy and Cliff Jackson, Billie Holiday, Hazel Scott, Lena Horne...
Café Society must have been quite a showcase...
